summary: Sales order S00034 is cancelled and no longer active. Clicking Cancel on the confirmed sales order opened Odoo's "Cancel Sales Order" wizard ("Are you sure you want to cancel this order?"); its buttons ignored mouse clicks, so I submitted the wizard's primary action with the keyboard instead. Odoo then displayed the status "Cancelled": in the statusbar the radio "Cancelled" is checked and disabled, all other states (Sales Order, Quotation Sent, Quotation) are greyed out, the Confirm/Send/Invoice buttons are gone and only Preview and Set to Quotation remain. I verified this survived a full page reload of record id=34, so it is persisted. A "Delivery failure" notification appeared in the chatter because the wizard tried to email the customer and this environment has no mail server — that is a side effect, not a failure of the cancellation.
